gaps.lead: Nobody else in the team runs as fast as Maya.
gaps.explanation: nobody runs faster = she is the fastest runner.

gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: Somebody needs to renew this passport before June.
gaps.explanation: need + -ing = need to be + participle: needs renewing.

gaps.lead: My grandfather planted all these apple trees himself.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather is the ___ all these apple trees.
gaps.explanation: 'the one who…' identifies the agent with a relative clause.

gaps.answer: can afford this holiday as long
gaps.lead: This holiday is within our price range, provided we don't go to the expensive restaurants in the tourist centre.
gaps.sentence: We ___ as we avoid the expensive restaurants in the tourist centre.
gaps.hint: provided = as long as; within our price range = can afford
gaps.explanation: 'Provided' is rewritten as 'as long as'; 'within our price range' as 'can afford'.
